angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 633,087 km at 105.68 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.4629 +/- 0.0183 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 105.68 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.91 +/- 0.025 solar radii from Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-77 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...636A..98C/abstract): 633,087 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.903 +/- 0.066 solar masses from Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-77 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...636A..98C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5617 +/- 72 K from Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-77 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...636A..98C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-77 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...636A..98C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-77-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.476, rounded to two decimals

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
